title: Keto Smoked Salmon Grilled Cheese
description: A keto version of a classic grilled cheese, featuring smoked salmon and a smoky flavor.

ingredients.name: Keto Grilled Cheese Bread (made with almond flour)

instructions: 1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
2. Lay the keto grilled cheese bread slices on a flat surface.
3. Spread a layer of mayonnaise on each bread slice.
4. Add a slice of cheese on each bread slice.
5. Top the cheese with smoked salmon, sliced red onion, and chopped fresh dill.
7. Place the other bread slice on top of the filling.
8. Grill for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until the cheese is melted and the bread is toasted.
